steps.text: From the detail view, click "Add meter" to open the meter selection dialog.
steps.title: Start adding a meter

steps.text: The dialog lists every meter in the community that is not yet attached to this sharing operation.
steps.title: Available meters

steps.text: Tick the checkbox of the meter you want to attach. Multiple meters can be selected before submitting.
steps.title: Tick the meter

steps.text: Tick the checkbox of the meter you want to attach. Multiple meters can be selected before submitting.
steps.title: Tick the meter

steps.text: Open the calendar and pick today's date so the meter attachment takes effect immediately.
steps.title: Start date today

steps.text: Click "Validate" to attach the meter. A toast notification confirms the server-side update.
steps.title: Confirm the addition

steps.text: Back on the detail view, the newly attached meter appears immediately in the "Now" tab of meters tied to the operation.
steps.title: Meter attached

steps.text: Back on the detail view, the card of the newly attached meter appears immediately in the "Now" tab of meters tied to the operation.
steps.title: Meter attached

title: Add a meter to a sharing operation
